_source: OSRIC 3.0 Player Guide §1.6.2.8 (NPC & Monster Reaction, Table 1.6.2.8A) and §1.6.8 (Morale, Table 1.6.8A). The Charisma reaction/loyalty modifiers referenced by the reaction roll live in ability_scores.json (charisma.<score>.reaction / .loyalty).

reaction.note: Roll d100, add the negotiator's Charisma reaction modifier (and any situational modifier), then read the band.

bands.result: Very hostile. Monsters attack; socially, absolute refusal / immediate steps to harm the disliked person.
Hostile. Monsters probably attack unless obviously outmatched; a delayed hostile response socially.
Unfavourable. Monsters probably attack; ~55% of next actions biased against the person.
Neutral. Monsters don't attack unless sure to win; NPCs wait to hear more.
Favourable. Monsters wait to hear an offer; ~55% of next actions biased in favour.
Friendly. Probably offers assistance if profitable.
Very friendly. May offer assistance even if unprofitable.

morale.note: Morale = 50% + 5% per hit die. Roll d100 (+ situational modifiers); roll <= morale passes. On failure the creatures retreat; a failure margin >= 51 indicates surrender. PCs never check; undead / mindless / fearless creatures never check. No more than two checks per battle.

modifiers._note: Cumulative; added to the d100 roll (positive = worse morale, more likely to fail).

situations.desc: Per friend killed, surrendered or fled
Own side greatly outnumbered (2:1 or more)
Per foe killed, surrendered or fled
Own side inflicted 50% casualties on the other side
